sentences.text: No, a Tier 4 UCB shall not levy prepayment charges on a floating-rate business loan to a Micro and Small Enterprise sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026.
The case fits the directions for loans sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 and for business-purpose loans to Micro and Small Enterprises.

The earlier directions that also barred pre-payment charges for Tier 4 Primary (Urban) Co-operative banks on business-purpose floating-rate loans to individuals and MSEs are no longer in force on the as-of date.
